answer: One defence is Stamped credit union membership with credit union regulator attestation: a membership the regulator kept across years of savers, and the jade of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a membership the regulator kept across years of savers is fresh per account, and the marble is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the sonnet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
